import collections
import math

int parse_integer(string text)
    return int(text)

void emit(string text)
    println(text)

string money(int amount)
    magnitude := math.abs(amount)
    return (if amount < 0 then "-" else "") + "{magnitude / 100}.{magnitude % 100:02.}"

int parse_cents(string text)
    fields := text.split(".")
    return 100 * parse_integer(fields[0]) + parse_integer(fields[1])

bool includes(const string[] values, string target)
    for value := values[]
        if value == target
            return true
    return false

bool leap(int year)
    return year % 4 == 0 and (year % 100 != 0 or year % 400 == 0)

int month_length(int year, int month)
    lengths := [31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]
    return lengths[month - 1] + (if month == 2 and leap(year) then 1 else 0)

class CalendarDate(int year, int month, int day)

int day_number(const CalendarDate date)
    prior := date.year - 1
    result := 365 * prior + prior / 4 - prior / 100 + prior / 400 + date.day - 730120
    for: 1 <= month < date.month
        result += month_length(date.year, month)
    return result

CalendarDate calendar_date(int number)
    year := 2000
    while number >= 365 + (if leap(year) then 1 else 0)
        number -= 365 + (if leap(year) then 1 else 0)
        year += 1
    month := 1
    while number >= month_length(year, month)
        number -= month_length(year, month)
        month += 1
    return CalendarDate(year, month, number + 1)

string date_text(int number)
    date := calendar_date(number)
    return "{date.year:04.}-{date.month:02.}-{date.day:02.}"

int | error checked_date(string text)
    fields := text.split("-")
    year := parse_integer(fields[0])
    month := parse_integer(fields[1])
    day := parse_integer(fields[2])
    if year < 2000 or year > 2099 or month < 1 or month > 12 or day < 1
        return error("invalid date " + text)
    if day > month_length(year, month)
        return error("invalid date " + text)
    return day_number(CalendarDate(year, month, day))

class DateRange(int first, int last)

DateRange | error checked_range(string first, string last)
    start := try checked_date(first)
    end := try checked_date(last)
    if start > end
        return error("invalid range " + first + " " + last)
    return DateRange(start, end)

int months_after(int number, int count)
    original := calendar_date(number)
    offset := original.month - 1 + count
    year := original.year + offset / 12
    month := offset % 12 + 1
    return day_number(CalendarDate(year, month, math.min(original.day, month_length(year, month))))

class Account(string code, string kind, string name)
    active := true
    int sign := if kind == "ASSET" or kind == "EXPENSE" then 1 else -1
    string family := if kind == "CONTRA_ASSET" then "ASSET" else kind

class PostingLine(bool debit, string code, int amount, string | none partner := none)

int line_difference(const PostingLine line)
    return if line.debit then line.amount else -line.amount

int[] line_totals(const PostingLine[] lines)
    debit := [for line := lines[] if line.debit then line.amount].sum()
    credit := [for line := lines[] if not line.debit then line.amount].sum()
    return [debit, credit]

class Entry(string id, int day, string category, string memo, PostingLine[] lines)
    int amount := line_totals(lines)[0]
    int | none reversed_by := none
    int | none reverses := none

class Template(string memo, PostingLine[] lines)
    uses := 0

class Draft(string kind, string key, string date_token, string memo)
    PostingLine[] lines := []

class CloseRecord(int day, int | none entry_index)

class Books()
    accounts := map<string, Account>()
    Entry[] entries := []
    entry_positions := map<string, int>()
    templates := map<string, Template>()
    Draft | none draft := none
    CloseRecord[] closes := []
    close_count := 0
    depreciation_count := 0
    interest_count := 0
    writeoff_count := 0

Account | error get_account(const Books books, string code, required := "")
    match books.accounts.get(code)
        Account found
            if required != "" and found.kind != required
                return error("wrong type " + code + " " + required)
            return found
        none
            return error("unknown account " + code)

int | error get_entry(const Books books, string id)
    match books.entry_positions.get(id)
        int index
            return index
        none
            return error("unknown entry " + id)

Template | error get_template(const Books books, string name)
    match books.templates.get(name)
        Template found
            return found
        none
            return error("unknown template " + name)

void | error active_check(const Books books, const string[] codes)
    for code := codes[]
        found := try get_account(books, code)
        if not found.active
            return error("inactive account " + code)
    return void

string closed_text(const Books books)
    return if #books.closes == 0 then "none" else date_text(books.closes[-1].day)

void | error check_closed(const Books books, int day)
    if #books.closes > 0 and day <= books.closes[-1].day
        return error("period closed " + date_text(day))
    return void

string[] ancestors(const Books books, string code)
    return [for other := books.accounts.keys().sorted()[] if other != code and code.starts_with(other) then other]

string parent_code(const Books books, string code)
    parents := ancestors(books, code)
    return if #parents == 0 then "none" else parents[-1]

string top_account(const Books books, string code)
    parents := ancestors(books, code)
    return if #parents == 0 then code else parents[0]

int[] total_pair(const map<string, int[]> totals, string code)
    match totals.get(code)
        int[] values
            return values
        none
            return [0, 0]

int difference(const map<string, int[]> totals, string code)
    values := total_pair(totals, code)
    return values[0] - values[1]

map<string, int[]> aggregate(const Books books, first := 0, last := 36524, operating := false)
    map<string, int[]> totals
    for posted := books.entries[]
        if posted.day < first or posted.day > last or (operating and includes(["closing", "reopen"], posted.category))
            continue
        for line := posted.lines[]
            values := total_pair(totals, line.code)
            values[if line.debit then 0 else 1] += line.amount
            .totals.set(line.code, values)
    return totals

int account_balance(const Books books, const Account account, day := 36524)
    return account.sign * difference(aggregate(books, last = day), account.code)

int daily_sum(const Books books, const Account account, int first, int last)
    result := 0
    for posted := books.entries[]
        if posted.day > last
            continue
        change := [for line := posted.lines[] if line.code == account.code then line_difference(line)].sum()
        result += account.sign * change * (last - math.max(first, posted.day) + 1)
    return result

int[] posting_order(const Books books)
    width := int(#books.entries) + 1
    keys := [for index := books.entries.indices()[] then books.entries[index].day * width + int(index)]
    return keys.sorted() % width

int post_entry(Books &books, string id, int day, string category, string memo, const PostingLine[] lines)
    index := int(#books.entries)
    books.entries = books.entries.append(Entry(id, day, category, memo, lines))
    .books.entry_positions.set(id, index)
    return index

int reverse_entry(Books &books, int index, int day, string category, string memo)
    original := books.entries[index]
    lines := [for line := original.lines[] then PostingLine(not line.debit, line.code, line.amount, line.partner)]
    created := post_entry(&books, original.id + "-R", day, category, memo, lines)
    books.entries[index].reversed_by = created
    books.entries[created].reverses = index
    return created

string posted_text(const Entry posted)
    return "POST {posted.id} {date_text(posted.day)} lines {#posted.lines} amount {money(posted.amount)}"

class OpenItem(int entry_index, int original, int remaining)
class Settlement()
    OpenItem[] items := []
    head := 0
    unapplied := 0

Settlement get_settlement(const map<string, Settlement> settlements, string partner)
    match settlements.get(partner)
        Settlement found
            return found
        none
            return Settlement()

map<string, Settlement> settlements_for(const Books books, const Account account, int day)
    map<string, Settlement> settlements
    for index := posting_order(books)[]
        posted := books.entries[index]
        if posted.day > day
            break
        for line := posted.lines[]
            if line.code != account.code
                continue
            string partner
            match line.partner
                string supplied
                    partner = supplied
                none
                    continue
            group := get_settlement(settlements, partner)
            signed := account.sign * line_difference(line)
            if signed > 0
                used := math.min(signed, group.unapplied)
                group.unapplied -= used
                if signed > used
                    group.items = group.items.append(OpenItem(index, signed, signed - used))
            else
                remaining := -signed
                while remaining > 0 and group.head < int(#group.items)
                    used := math.min(remaining, group.items[group.head].remaining)
                    group.items[group.head].remaining -= used
                    remaining -= used
                    if group.items[group.head].remaining == 0
                        group.head += 1
                group.unapplied += remaining
            .settlements.set(partner, group)
    return settlements

int section(const Books books, string heading, const string[] kinds, int sign, const map<string, int[]> totals, extra := 0, show_extra := false)
    string[] selected := []
    distinct<string> roots
    for code := books.accounts.keys().sorted()[]
        account := get_account(books, code)
        if includes(kinds, account.kind)
            selected = selected.append(code)
            .roots.add(top_account(books, code))
    total := extra + sign * [for code := selected[] then difference(totals, code)].sum()
    emit("  {heading} {money(total)}")
    for root := roots.sorted()[]
        group := [for code := selected[] if top_account(books, code) == root then code]
        nonzero := [for code := group[] if difference(totals, code) != 0 then code]
        if #nonzero == 0
            continue
        parent := get_account(books, root)
        subtotal := sign * [for code := group[] then difference(totals, code)].sum()
        emit("    {root} {parent.name} {money(subtotal)}")
        for code := nonzero[]
            account := get_account(books, code)
            emit("      {code} {account.name} {money(sign * difference(totals, code))}")
    if show_extra
        emit("    current earnings {money(extra)}")
    return total

string aging_columns(const int[] values)
    return "0-30 {money(values[0])} 31-60 {money(values[1])} 61-90 {money(values[2])} 91+ {money(values[3])} unapplied {money(values[4])} balance {money(values[0:<4].sum() - values[4])}"

void | error post_draft(Books &books)
    Draft block
    match books.draft
        Draft found
            block = found
        none
            return error("no open entry")
    books.draft = none
    day := 0
    if block.kind == "journal"
        if books.entry_positions.has(block.key)
            return error("duplicate entry " + block.key)
        day = try checked_date(block.date_token)
        try check_closed(books, day)
    elif books.templates.has(block.key)
        return error("duplicate template " + block.key)
    if #block.lines < 2
        return error("too few lines " + block.key)
    for line := block.lines[]
        account := try get_account(books, line.code)
        if block.kind == "journal" and not account.active
            return error("inactive account " + line.code)
        if line.amount == 0
            return error("zero amount " + line.code)
    values := line_totals(block.lines)
    if values[0] != values[1]
        return error("unbalanced {block.key} debit {money(values[0])} credit {money(values[1])}")
    if block.kind == "journal"
        index := post_entry(&books, block.key, day, "journal", block.memo, block.lines)
        emit(posted_text(books.entries[index]))
    else
        .books.templates.set(block.key, Template(block.memo, block.lines))
        emit("TEMPLATE {block.key} lines {#block.lines} amount {money(values[0])}")
    return void

void | error command(Books &books, const string[] words)
    op := words[0]
    if op == "ACCOUNT"
        code := words[1]
        if books.accounts.has(code)
            return error("duplicate account " + code)
        account := Account(code, words[2], words[3])
        for other := books.accounts.keys().sorted()[]
            existing := get_account(books, other)
            if (code.starts_with(other) or other.starts_with(code)) and account.family != existing.family
                return error("class mismatch " + code + " " + other)
        .books.accounts.set(code, account)
        emit("ACCOUNT {code} {account.kind} {account.name} parent {parent_code(books, code)}")
    elif op == "DEACTIVATE"
        account := try get_account(books, words[1])
        if not account.active
            return error("already inactive " + account.code)
        balance := account_balance(books, account)
        if balance != 0
            return error("nonzero balance {account.code} {money(balance)}")
        account.active = false
        .books.accounts.set(account.code, account)
        emit("DEACTIVATE {account.code} {account.name}")
    elif op == "JOURNAL" or op == "TEMPLATE"
        match books.draft
            Draft discarded
                emit("DISCARD {discarded.key} lines {#discarded.lines}")
            none
                books.draft = none
        books.draft = if op == "JOURNAL" then Draft("journal", words[1], words[2], words[3]) else Draft("template", words[1], "", words[2])
    elif op == "DR" or op == "CR"
        Draft block
        match books.draft
            Draft found
                block = found
            none
                return error("no open entry")
        string | none partner := none
        if #words == 4
            partner = words[3]
        block.lines = block.lines.append(PostingLine(op == "DR", words[1], parse_cents(words[2]), partner))
        books.draft = block
    elif op == "POST"
        return post_draft(&books)
    elif op == "DRAFT"
        match books.draft
            Draft block
                values := line_totals(block.lines)
                emit("DRAFT {block.kind} {block.key} lines {#block.lines} debit {money(values[0])} credit {money(values[1])} difference {money(values[0] - values[1])}")
            none
                return error("no open entry")
    elif op == "REVERSE"
        index := try get_entry(books, words[1])
        original := books.entries[index]
        if includes(["reversal", "closing", "reopen"], original.category)
            return error("cannot reverse " + original.id)
        match original.reversed_by
            int prior
                return error("already reversed " + original.id)
            none
                original.reversed_by = none
        day := try checked_date(words[2])
        if day < original.day
            return error("reverse before entry {original.id} {date_text(original.day)}")
        try check_closed(books, day)
        try active_check(books, [for line := original.lines[] then line.code])
        created := reverse_entry(&books, index, day, "reversal", original.memo)
        posted := books.entries[created]
        emit("REVERSE {original.id} entry {posted.id} {date_text(day)} amount {money(posted.amount)}")
    elif op == "RECUR"
        pattern := try get_template(books, words[1])
        day := try checked_date(words[2])
        count := parse_integer(words[3])
        if count == 0
            return error("invalid count")
        try check_closed(books, day)
        try active_check(books, [for line := pattern.lines[] then line.code])
        emit("RECUR {words[1]} count {count}")
        for: 0 <= offset < count
            pattern.uses += 1
            index := post_entry(&books, "{words[1]}-{pattern.uses}", months_after(day, offset), "recurring", pattern.memo, pattern.lines)
            emit("  " + posted_text(books.entries[index]))
        .books.templates.set(words[1], pattern)
    elif op == "DEPRECIATE"
        day := try checked_date(words[1])
        try check_closed(books, day)
        asset := try get_account(books, words[2], "ASSET")
        contra := try get_account(books, words[3], "CONTRA_ASSET")
        expense := try get_account(books, words[4], "EXPENSE")
        try active_check(books, [contra.code, expense.code])
        cost := account_balance(books, asset, day)
        accumulated := account_balance(books, contra, day)
        amount := if cost > 0 then math.min(cost / parse_integer(words[5]), cost - accumulated) else 0
        if amount <= 0
            return error("nothing to depreciate " + asset.code)
        books.depreciation_count += 1
        id := "DEP-{books.depreciation_count}"
        post_entry(&books, id, day, "depreciation", "depreciation", [PostingLine(true, expense.code, amount), PostingLine(false, contra.code, amount)])
        emit("DEPRECIATE {asset.code} entry {id} {date_text(day)} amount {money(amount)} accumulated {money(accumulated + amount)} book {money(cost - accumulated - amount)}")
    elif op == "INTEREST"
        account := try get_account(books, words[1])
        if account.kind != "ASSET" and account.kind != "LIABILITY"
            return error("not interest bearing " + account.code)
        offset := try get_account(books, words[2], if account.kind == "ASSET" then "REVENUE" else "EXPENSE")
        period := try checked_range(words[3], words[4])
        try check_closed(books, period.last)
        try active_check(books, [account.code, offset.code])
        sum := daily_sum(books, account, period.first, period.last)
        amount := sum * parse_integer(words[5]) / 3650000
        if amount <= 0
            return error("no interest " + account.code)
        books.interest_count += 1
        id := "INT-{books.interest_count}"
        debit := if account.kind == "ASSET" then account.code else offset.code
        credit := if account.kind == "ASSET" then offset.code else account.code
        post_entry(&books, id, period.last, "interest", "interest", [PostingLine(true, debit, amount), PostingLine(false, credit, amount)])
        days := period.last - period.first + 1
        emit("INTEREST {account.code} entry {id} {date_text(period.last)} days {days} average {money(sum / days)} amount {money(amount)}")
    elif op == "WRITEOFF"
        day := try checked_date(words[1])
        try check_closed(books, day)
        account := try get_account(books, words[2], "ASSET")
        expense := try get_account(books, words[3], "EXPENSE")
        try active_check(books, [account.code, expense.code])
        age_limit := parse_integer(words[4])
        settlements := settlements_for(books, account, day)
        string[] partners := []
        int[] amounts := []
        for partner := settlements.keys().sorted()[]
            group := get_settlement(settlements, partner)
            amount := [for item := group.items[group.head:][] if day - books.entries[item.entry_index].day > age_limit then item.remaining].sum()
            if amount > 0
                partners = partners.append(partner)
                amounts = amounts.append(amount)
        total := amounts.sum()
        if total == 0
            return error("nothing to write off " + account.code)
        lines := [PostingLine(true, expense.code, total)]
        for index := partners.indices()[]
            lines = lines.append(PostingLine(false, account.code, amounts[index], partners[index]))
        books.writeoff_count += 1
        id := "WO-{books.writeoff_count}"
        post_entry(&books, id, day, "writeoff", "writeoff", lines)
        emit("WRITEOFF {account.code} entry {id} {date_text(day)} partners {#partners} amount {money(total)}")
        for index := partners.indices()[]
            emit("  {partners[index]} {money(amounts[index])}")
    elif op == "CLOSE"
        day := try checked_date(words[1])
        try check_closed(books, day)
        equity := try get_account(books, words[2], "EQUITY")
        try active_check(books, [equity.code])
        totals := aggregate(books, last = day)
        string[] selected := []
        for code := books.accounts.keys().sorted()[]
            account := get_account(books, code)
            if includes(["REVENUE", "EXPENSE"], account.kind) and difference(totals, code) != 0
                selected = selected.append(code)
        try active_check(books, selected)
        PostingLine[] lines := []
        for code := selected[]
            delta := difference(totals, code)
            lines = lines.append(PostingLine(delta < 0, code, math.abs(delta)))
        income := -[for code := selected[] then difference(totals, code)].sum()
        if income != 0
            lines = lines.append(PostingLine(income < 0, equity.code, math.abs(income)))
        books.close_count += 1
        int | none posted := none
        if #lines > 0
            id := "CLOSE-{books.close_count}"
            posted = post_entry(&books, id, day, "closing", "closing", lines)
            emit("CLOSE {date_text(day)} entry {id} lines {#lines} net income {money(income)}")
        else
            emit("CLOSE {date_text(day)} no entry")
        books.closes = books.closes.append(CloseRecord(day, posted))
    elif op == "REOPEN"
        if #books.closes == 0
            return error("nothing to reopen")
        record := books.closes[-1]
        detail := "no entry"
        match record.entry_index
            int index
                original := books.entries[index]
                try active_check(books, [for line := original.lines[] then line.code])
                created := reverse_entry(&books, index, record.day, "reopen", "reopen")
                detail = "entry " + books.entries[created].id
            none
                detail = "no entry"
        books.closes = books.closes[0:<int(#books.closes) - 1]
        emit("REOPEN {date_text(record.day)} {detail} closed {closed_text(books)}")
    elif op == "LEDGER"
        account := try get_account(books, words[1])
        period := try checked_range(words[2], words[3])
        running := account_balance(books, account, period.first - 1)
        debit := 0
        credit := 0
        emit("LEDGER {account.code} {account.name} {date_text(period.first)} {date_text(period.last)}")
        emit("  opening {money(running)}")
        for index := posting_order(books)[]
            posted := books.entries[index]
            if posted.day < period.first or posted.day > period.last
                continue
            for line := posted.lines[]
                if line.code != account.code
                    continue
                running += account.sign * line_difference(line)
                if line.debit
                    debit += line.amount
                else
                    credit += line.amount
                side := if line.debit then "DR" else "CR"
                emit("  {date_text(posted.day)} {posted.id} {side} {money(line.amount)} balance {money(running)} {posted.memo}")
        days := period.last - period.first + 1
        average := daily_sum(books, account, period.first, period.last) / days
        emit("  ending {money(running)} debits {money(debit)} credits {money(credit)} days {days} average {money(average)}")
    elif op == "ACTIVITY"
        account := try get_account(books, words[1])
        year := parse_integer(words[2])
        total := [0, 0]
        emit("ACTIVITY {account.code} {account.name} {year}")
        for: 1 <= month <= 12
            first := day_number(CalendarDate(year, month, 1))
            last := first + month_length(year, month) - 1
            values := total_pair(aggregate(books, first, last), account.code)
            total += values
            emit("  {year:04.}-{month:02.} debit {money(values[0])} credit {money(values[1])} balance {money(account_balance(books, account, last))}")
        emit("  total debit {money(total[0])} credit {money(total[1])}")
    elif op == "TRIAL"
        day := try checked_date(words[1])
        totals := aggregate(books, last = day)
        debit := 0
        credit := 0
        emit("TRIAL " + date_text(day))
        for code := books.accounts.keys().sorted()[]
            delta := difference(totals, code)
            if delta == 0
                continue
            account := get_account(books, code)
            side := if delta > 0 then "debit" else "credit"
            emit("  {code} {account.name} {side} {money(math.abs(delta))}")
            if delta > 0
                debit += delta
            else
                credit -= delta
        emit("  total debit {money(debit)} credit {money(credit)}")
    elif op == "INCOME"
        period := try checked_range(words[1], words[2])
        totals := aggregate(books, period.first, period.last, operating = true)
        emit("INCOME {date_text(period.first)} {date_text(period.last)}")
        revenue := section(books, "REVENUE", ["REVENUE"], -1, totals)
        expense := section(books, "EXPENSE", ["EXPENSE"], 1, totals)
        emit("  NET INCOME " + money(revenue - expense))
    elif op == "BALANCE"
        day := try checked_date(words[1])
        totals := aggregate(books, last = day)
        string[] income_codes := []
        for code := books.accounts.keys()[]
            account := get_account(books, code)
            if includes(["REVENUE", "EXPENSE"], account.kind)
                income_codes = income_codes.append(code)
        earnings := -[for code := income_codes[] then difference(totals, code)].sum()
        emit("BALANCE " + date_text(day))
        assets := section(books, "ASSETS", ["ASSET", "CONTRA_ASSET"], 1, totals)
        liabilities := section(books, "LIABILITIES", ["LIABILITY"], -1, totals)
        equity := section(books, "EQUITY", ["EQUITY"], -1, totals, earnings, show_extra = true)
        emit(if assets == liabilities + equity then "  check ok" else "  check mismatch " + money(assets - liabilities - equity))
    elif op == "ROLLUP"
        day := try checked_date(words[2])
        selected := [for code := books.accounts.keys().sorted()[] if code.starts_with(words[1]) then code]
        emit("ROLLUP {words[1]} {date_text(day)}")
        if #selected == 0
            emit("  (none)")
            return void
        totals := aggregate(books, last = day)
        postings := [0, 0]
        for code := selected[]
            account := get_account(books, code)
            descendants := [for other := selected[] if other.starts_with(code) then other]
            parents := [for other := selected[] if other != code and code.starts_with(other) then other]
            subtotal := account.sign * [for other := descendants[] then difference(totals, other)].sum()
            string padding := " " * (2 * (1 + #parents))
            emit("{padding}{code} {account.name} own {money(account.sign * difference(totals, code))} total {money(subtotal)}")
            postings += total_pair(totals, code)
        emit("  postings debit {money(postings[0])} credit {money(postings[1])}")
    elif op == "AGING" or op == "ITEMS"
        account := try get_account(books, words[1])
        day := try checked_date(words[-1])
        settlements := settlements_for(books, account, day)
        if op == "ITEMS"
            group := get_settlement(settlements, words[2])
            emit("ITEMS {account.code} {account.name} {words[2]} {date_text(day)}")
            items := group.items[group.head:]
            for item := items[]
                posted := books.entries[item.entry_index]
                emit("  {date_text(posted.day)} {posted.id} amount {money(item.original)} open {money(item.remaining)} age {day - posted.day}")
            balance := [for item := items[] then item.remaining].sum() - group.unapplied
            emit("  unapplied {money(group.unapplied)} balance {money(balance)}")
        else
            emit("AGING {account.code} {account.name} {date_text(day)}")
            totals := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
            for partner := settlements.keys().sorted()[]
                group := get_settlement(settlements, partner)
                if group.head == int(#group.items) and group.unapplied == 0
                    continue
                values := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
                for item := group.items[group.head:][]
                    age := day - books.entries[item.entry_index].day
                    bucket := if age <= 30 then 0 elif age <= 60 then 1 elif age <= 90 then 2 else 3
                    values[bucket] += item.remaining
                values[4] = group.unapplied
                totals += values
                emit("  {partner} " + aging_columns(values))
            emit("  total " + aging_columns(totals))
    elif op == "ENTRY"
        index := try get_entry(books, words[1])
        posted := books.entries[index]
        emit("ENTRY {posted.id} {date_text(posted.day)} {posted.category} {posted.memo}")
        for line := posted.lines[]
            account := get_account(books, line.code)
            side := if line.debit then "DR" else "CR"
            detail := "  {side} {line.code} {account.name} {money(line.amount)}"
            match line.partner
                string partner
                    detail += " " + partner
                none
                    detail += ""
            emit(detail)
        emit("  total " + money(posted.amount))
        match posted.reverses
            int original
                emit("  reverses " + books.entries[original].id)
            none
                posted.reverses = none
        match posted.reversed_by
            int reversal
                emit("  reversed by " + books.entries[reversal].id)
            none
                posted.reversed_by = none
    elif op == "DAYBOOK"
        period := try checked_range(words[1], words[2])
        count := 0
        total := 0
        emit("DAYBOOK {date_text(period.first)} {date_text(period.last)}")
        for index := posting_order(books)[]
            posted := books.entries[index]
            if posted.day < period.first or posted.day > period.last
                continue
            count += 1
            total += posted.amount
            emit("  {date_text(posted.day)} {posted.id} {posted.category} {money(posted.amount)} {posted.memo}")
        emit("  total entries {count} amount {money(total)}")
    elif op == "ACCOUNTS"
        emit("ACCOUNTS")
        codes := books.accounts.keys().sorted()
        if #codes == 0
            emit("  (none)")
        totals := aggregate(books)
        for code := codes[]
            account := get_account(books, code)
            status := if account.active then "active" else "inactive"
            emit("  {code} {account.kind} {account.name} parent {parent_code(books, code)} balance {money(account.sign * difference(totals, code))} {status}")
    elif op == "TEMPLATES"
        emit("TEMPLATES")
        names := books.templates.keys().sorted()
        if #names == 0
            emit("  (none)")
        for name := names[]
            pattern := get_template(books, name)
            emit("  {name} {pattern.memo} lines {#pattern.lines} amount {money(line_totals(pattern.lines)[0])} used {pattern.uses}")
    elif op == "STATUS"
        inactive := 0
        for account := books.accounts.values()[]
            if not account.active
                inactive += 1
        open := "none"
        match books.draft
            Draft block
                open = block.key
            none
                open = "none"
        emit("STATUS accounts {books.accounts.size()} inactive {inactive} entries {#books.entries} templates {books.templates.size()} closed {closed_text(books)} open {open}")
    return void
